newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat says Israel to free prisoners by Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says Israel to free prisoners by Wednesday.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said on Monday Israel would free the Palestinian women prisoners it holds on either Tuesday or Wednesday.
Israel announced on Friday it was going to free the 25 prisoners within days, as part of peace agreements with the PLO.
Arafat said in an interview with Abu Dhabi Television: "Tomorrow evening or the day after tomorrow in the morning all the women prisoners will be released."
A Palestinian official in Gaza said there were 28 women prisoners who would be taken to the West Bank town of Ramallah, where Arafat would personally receive them.
Israeli officials declined to comment on the details of the release.
